summary: Rewrote the makefiles (generated headers in build/gen, order-only gen deps, -MMD header tracking, correct link order and libqs.a dependency, config stamp for DEBUG=1, working check exit status, spec-conformant install with PREFIX/DESTDIR and pkg-config) and removed the stale hand-kept include/qs/ops.h. Fixed all -Wall -Wextra -Werror warnings in the C sources without changing behavior (and made the neg operand follow strictly tighter operators); verified clean builds at -j1/8/32 for every target, make check, make install, DEBUG=1, and incremental rebuilds.
